not_covered.text: Twelve migrants, including an infant, are killed when two separate speedboats capsize off the coast of the Lesbos and Samos islands in Greece.
Six miners are killed and at least 12 others are missing when an open pit gold mine collapses in Nariño Department, Colombia.

not_covered.text: Andorra and San Marino each sign an association agreement with the European Union.

Germany summons its Iranian ambassador after a German court sentences two men involved in a plot to kill a Jewish community leader, saying one of them had been directed by Iran's intelligence service.
